relations_to.summary: Presidential decree set 2026 for full WTO accession; the WTO Director-General hoped for membership by March 2026 and the 14th Ministerial Conference (26-29 Mar 2026) was to adopt it, but in March 2026 Tashkent was still negotiating 3-8 year transition periods for sensitive industries. No later outcome found.

sources.title: WTO hopes to welcome Uzbekistan as member in early 2026
Economic growth and foreign markets: why Uzbekistan is accelerating WTO accession
